I was prescribed antidepressants and anxiety medication. I have never felt better in my entire life. I can focus, I can work, Im able to do and continue moving without the crippling anxiety I was suffering from.
I was diagnosed with Depression.

I went to talk to my doc and told her what I was experiencing. She was blown away on how I had not reached out any earlier. She said I was having INSANE panick attacks (i thought I was just worried, normal) I had to talk to a psychiatrist. I told my life story.

Days went by and I still couldn’t get a hold of myself. These were times of daily crying and drinking. I couldn’t understand what the fuck was wrong with me? How could this be normal life? I didn't want to live.

My mood finally stabilized. The way they explained it to me was that meds are supposed to flatten the line of mood ups and downs. My lows were TOO low and my highs were TOO high. Meds are supposed to give you a happy medium.
